title: On oriented Turán problems
summary: The oriented Turán number of a given oriented graph $\overrightarrow{F}$, denoted by $\exo(n,\overrightarrow{F})$, is the largest number of arcs in $n$-vertex $\overrightarrow{F}$-free oriented graphs. This concept could be seen as an oriented version of the classical Turán number. In this paper, we first prove several propositions that give exact results for several oriented graphs. In particular, we determine all exact values of $\exo(n,\overrightarrow{F})$ for every oriented graph $\overrightarrow{F}$ with at most three arcs and sufficiently large $n$.
